The plot involved a cell allegedly affiliated with Hezbollah, according to a statement from the Internal Security Forces. Authorities said the operation disrupted the planned attack. title: Schneider: Built locally, Gulf industry is ready for the AI shift
description: DUBAI: The Gulf's AI story is usually told in gigawatts and billions of dollars. Walid Sheta, Schneider Electric's president for the Middle East and Africa, thinks the number that matters more is distance: how far a data centre sits from the factory that builds it. "To build a data centre, you'd better have capabilities not only in engineering but also in assembly and manufacturing, close to where you build the data centre," Sheta told Arab News.

title: Israel seizes land near Jenin for military use amid settlement expansion
description: Israeli authorities have seized an 8,645-sq.-meter plot of land in the Palestinian village of Deir Abu Da’if for military purposes, as part of ongoing settlement expansion efforts in the West Bank. This move, according to local officials, aims to consolidate control over Palestinian land and restrict the development of local communities, amid widespread international condemnation of such actions as illegal under international law.

description: Sweden, Finland, and their allies now face a challenge in countering Russian behavior without stoking tensions further.

title: A cultural stroll through Paris with actors François-Xavier Demaison and François Morel
description: This week, we bring you a special programme dedicated to theatre. Valérie Fayolle takes us to the Renaissance Theatre, where François-Xavier Demaison takes us behind the scenes of "Laponie". The fiesty comedy shows how a family's holiday gathering can quickly turn into a settling of scores. "Theatre is one of our last collective experiences. It's magnificent, we're in a bubble," he tells us.

title: Trump says US will halt $4 billion in aid to Israel after end of the year
description: President Donald Trump on Tuesday said that the United States will stop $4 billion in funding to Israel after the end of this year. While speaking to Fox News' Fox and Friends, the US president added that Israel no longer needed the aid from Washington, and that some politicians were using the funding to criticise Republicans.

title: 2026 Prix Goncourt: France's prestigious literary prize awarded to Philippe Jaenada
description: France’s prestigious literary prize “The Goncourt” was awarded on Monday to writer Philippe Jaenada. The prize carries a symbolic reward of only 10 euros, but results in considerable recognition and book sales for the winning author. FRANCE 24’s Culture reporter Olivia Salazar-Winspear reports from the Parisian restaurant where the jury made the call.

title: Americans vote in key midterms set to upend Trump presidency
description: Americans voted on Tuesday in pivotal midterm elections with Democrats hoping to seize control of Congress and impose the first significant checks on Donald Trump's chaotic second term in the White House. Republicans losing the House would give Democrats the power to stall Trump's legislative agenda and launch sweeping investigations of his administration. FRANCE 24's Fraser Jackson reports from Washington, DC.

title: Israeli opposition leaders vow to remove Netanyahu quickly but path unclear
description: The Israeli opposition bloc led by Gadi Eisenkot pledged Tuesday to form a government quickly to oust Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu but remained unclear on how, with divisions over whether to ally with Arab lawmakers. Arab-majority parties last week won 19 seats in the 120-member parliament. Eisenkot's diverse opposition bloc won 48 seats while Netanyahu's camp secured 53, of which 27 are from his Likud party.

title: US midterm elections: A referendum on President Donald Trump?
description: Americans deliver their verdict on Donald Trump's tumultuous first term in midterm elections that threaten to shatter his grip on Washington, with Democrats poised to seize the House and within striking distance of the Senate.

title: Californians vote on ballot initiative to impose one-time tax on billionaires
description: This Tuesday, Californians are voting on a landmark plan to impose a one-time tax on billionaires to fund the state's healthcare system. We take a closer look. Also on the show: global oil prices fell sharply on the eve of the US midterm elections.
